notes.title: New Dating Sim Visual Novel - Memories on the Shoreline
notes.content:
Hey guys, just a quick heads up that our newest otome dating sim visual novel, Memories on the Shoreline, has just released! If you enjoy dating sims (which I'm sure most of your do), then check this one out- you can date a merman in it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108631/87c42629df9f41116d9d817739d00d2583bfe34d.jpg

Steam Page for Memories on the Shoreline

Memories on the Shoreline is an otome dating sim featuring Melody, a med student, on her vacation of a lifetime where she meets two bachelors while at the beach. Brennan, the cheeky lady's man who's a bit overprotective, and Crylis, the fugitive merman who's hides behind a lot of snark. How exactly is she going to get herself out of this trouble—?!

It's been quite a few months since we came up with the idea for this and started drafting it and we're happy to finally release another visual novel to you guys. We hope you enjoy!
